overall.summary: The youth part leaves out its relay node 8375, so coverage is not full and its formula does not reproduce, and the record and the youth hypothesis place the age hinge at about 41 years when it is at about 35. The other parts reproduce.

findings.evidence: the youth part's contribution falls 0.161 per year up to 35 years and is flat from 35 (exit 0.463 at 35, 36, ... 50); risk 61.9% at 35, 38, 41 and 44 years.
